description: The file defines the JsonField interface, representing a single JSON key-value pair with meta-information capabilities, including methods for creating instances, accessing key and value, checking markers, and serialization.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new JsonField instance with a specified key and value.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new JsonField instance with a specified key, value, and definition.

methods.name: isValueNonNull
methods.description: Returns a predicate to check if the JSON field's value is not null.

methods.name: getKeyName
methods.description: Returns the name of the JSON field's key.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the JsonKey object representing the field's key.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the JsonValue of the field.

methods.name: getDefinition
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the field's definition, if present.

methods.name: isMarkedAs
methods.description: Checks if the field is marked with the specified markers.

methods.name: writeKeyAndValue
methods.description: Serializes the field's key and value into the provided serialization context.
